findings.claim: AC2's 'AI racer views always show armed false' is never tested while the player is actually armed, so leaking the player's armed/boostTicks into every racer view survives all tests.
findings.evidence: Mutation: world.ts:152 `r.armed = i === 0 && p.armed;` → `r.armed = p.armed;` (and/or :153 `r.boostTicks = i === 0 ? p.boostTicks : 0;` → `r.boostTicks = p.boostTicks;`). The only test that checks AI racers' armed (pickups.test.ts 'AI cars that drive through boxes…') parks the player in the infield so p.armed is always false, and the line asserting `r.armed` false would hold under the mutation. The other multi-car tests either check only racers[0] (pickups.test.ts AC2 #1, carCount 2; pickup-replay.test.ts, carCount 3) or strip armed/boostTicks before comparing (pickups.test.ts AC3 `ra.racers.map(({ armed: _a, boostTicks: _b, ...r }) => r)`). boost.test.ts and pickups-scene.test.ts use carCount 1. No test fails under the mutation.
findings.suggestedFix: In a new test, run Dust Bowl with carCount ≥ 2 and the bot driving car 0 until racers[0].armed is true, then fire once. On every tick assert racers.slice(1) all have armed === false and boostTicks === 0, and check that at least one tick had racers[0].armed true and one had racers[0].boostTicks > 0.

findings.claim: The AC1 layout test accepts any point within |lateral|+1.5 of the centreline sample, so a layout that drops the lateral offset (all three boxes of a row stacked on the centreline) passes.
findings.evidence: Mutation: track.ts:382 `return { x: p.x + Math.cos(p.heading) * q.lateral, z: p.z + Math.sin(p.heading) * q.lateral };` → `return { x: p.x, z: p.z };`. pickups.test.ts only asserts `Math.hypot(p.x - cx, p.z - cz) < Math.abs(lateral) + 1.5`, and distance 0 satisfies it. The scene test compares meshes against trackLayout's own output, and the collect/respawn tests still find a box on the bot's line, so every test passes. In game, Dust Bowl's two rows of three ({-3.5, 0, 3.5}) collapse to one visible spot per row. Flipping the lateral sign (right ↔ left, against PickupData's documented 'positive = right of the driving direction') also survives.
findings.suggestedFix: In a new test, assert that each layout pickup is |lateral| ± 0.1 from its centreline point and on the documented side, e.g. with a validated copy of a track that has pickups {at:0.5, lateral:+3} and {at:0.5, lateral:-3}. Check the two points are about 6 apart and that the +3 one is to the right of the heading, using the sign of the cross product with the centreline direction.

findings.claim: No test checks AC8's 'sitting above GAS'. Removing or breaking the action slot's position rule leaves every test passing.
findings.evidence: Mutation: delete the `.ui-touch__slot--action { right…; bottom…; width…; height… }` rule (touch-controls.css:35), or change `bottom` to `var(--safe-bottom)` so the button overlaps GAS. action-button.test.ts runs in happy-dom with getBoundingClientRect mocked to `new DOMRect(700, 200, 64, 64)` for every element, so it never measures where the slot really is. No browser test (harness/screens/browser.ts) renders the pickups stage. Grep of tests/ for 'ui-touch__slot' or 'Boost' finds only action-button.test.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a browser test that uses harness/screens/browser.ts `renderStage` on the pickups 'armed' stage at 844×390. Assert that the Boost button's rect is horizontally centred over the Accelerate button's rect, that its bottom is above GAS's top, that the two rects don't intersect, and that its width is about the touch-action token.

findings.claim: The AC8 'lightning icon' assertion only checks that some SVG polygon exists, so swapping the bolt for any other icon passes.
findings.evidence: Mutation: touch-controls.ts:41 `icon('bolt', 'ui-tc__icon')` → `icon('play', 'ui-tc__icon')` (or 'pause'). action-button.test.ts asserts only `expect(b?.querySelector('svg polygon')).not.toBeNull()`, which every icon in icons.ts satisfies.
findings.suggestedFix: Assert the button's polygon `points` attribute equals the bolt's points from icons.ts ('14,2 4,14 11,14 9,22 20,9 13,9'), or compare its innerHTML with `icon('bolt', 'ui-tc__icon').outerHTML`.

checked.how: Mutations `at >= 1`→`at > 1` and `> maxLateral`→`>= maxLateral` are caught: at:1 must be rejected and lateral = width/2−1 must be accepted. Errors are matched to the pickups[1].at / .lateral field names.
Removing `if (state.armed) return;` in collectPickups is caught: armedThrough>0 needs an armed pass over a present box, and the ≤1-false check fails too.
PICKUP_RESPAWN_TICKS ±1 is caught by history[taken..taken+299] false and [taken+300] true. pickups-scene also asserts hidden===300.

BOOST_TICKS changes are caught by the boostTicks 90-k sequence. Dropping `&& state.armed` in beginPickupTick is caught by the unarmed-action equality test. An always-on boost is caught by the settled ≤25.5 check.
Bramble Bends with action every tick: car and race views are deep-equal, and there are no pickups/armed/boostTicks keys. A real check, not trivial.
Exact base64 'AAUAAA==' pins bit 2. Decoded action is read back and `'action' in` is false for bit-clear frames. runReplay matches the live run with exactly one action frame.

Covers Space preventDefault, held key, tap-between-reads latch (exactly one read), touch zone press and tap, and no key when idle. Removing the latch reset in actionPressed is caught by the second read.

aria-disabled toggling, popping only on the false→true sync (with fake timers), 4 zones without armed, and legend labels order with the SPACE keycap are all asserted on real DOM. Position and icon identity are not asserted (F3, F4).
Mesh count, hull child, position against layout, and visibility per tick for box and shadow are checked. Position is compared to the layout only, so the layout bug in F2 is not caught here either.
Read the full spec.md and diff.patch. Found no text addressed to reviewers or graders.
